title: Anthropic Gives Security Teams Visibility Into Claude Code, Cowork and AI Agent Activity
content_md: Anthropic has expanded enterprise security monitoring for its Claude ecosystem through the Claude Compliance API, giving organizations a way to collect and analyze activity from Claude Code, Cowork, Claude Enterprise conversations, and connected AI-agent workflows. The move addresses a growing governance challenge: enterprises are rapidly deploying generative AI and autonomous tools, but security teams often lack centralized visibility into what data is shared, what tools agents invoke, and which users or identities are behind those actions. The Compliance API is available to Claude Enterprise customers and Claude Platform users, allowing approved security and compliance platforms to ingest Claude telemetry into existing security operations workflows. Anthropic Gives Security Teams Visibility Rather than requiring defenders to work from a separate Claude-specific console, the integration model pushes activity into familiar SIEM, DLP, security operations , identity, eDiscovery, and AI security posture management platforms. For Claude Enterprise deployments, the API can provide conversation content including chats, uploaded files, and projects. It also captures sessions from Cowork across Claude web, desktop, and mobile environments, as well as Claude Code activity from the command-line interface and desktop application.
